_comment: Textures dropped only when a MEASUREMENT says the pack's own art cannot work, as opposed to drop_list.json which holds unconditional version facts. Five entries used to sit in drop_list because M8SON's versions were bad; that threw the same textures away in every other pack too. Each predicate is evaluated per pack and the measured number goes in the findings, so every decision is explainable rather than asserted. Thresholds calibrated on the 173-pack corpus, 2026-08-02.
_slot_presence: Each expected 18x18 slot is scored by its FOUR borders against the interior, not by one ring average. Score = min(-left, -top) across the slots, i.e. how dark the two shadowed edges are; and any edge more than max_lift brighter than the interior scores 0 outright. WHY NOT A RING AVERAGE: a 1.7-era pack has ONE slot sitting BETWEEN 1.8.9's two positions, so both sample boxes clip a piece of its border and both score well. SOUPSKIDZ4LIFE passed that way at 7.0/5.8 and rendered in-game with Minecraft's two slots drawn over its single one (Mason, 2026-08-02); its clipped edges read +75 and +71 brighter than interior, which max_lift=30 now catches. Only LEFT and TOP are required dark because Minecraft slots are inset and BOTTOM/RIGHT are the bevel's lit side. min_score=8 has real margin: M8SON (one slot, 1.7-era) reads 3.1 and drops, Kiro FPS V2 cRed reads 24.5 and keeps -- Mason confirmed Kiro's enchanting table renders correctly in-game. CONSERVATIVE BY DESIGN: it keeps 13 of 142 corpus packs. Dropping good art costs a vanilla GUI; keeping bad art ships a visibly broken one, and the 07-31 and 08-02 failures were both false POSITIVES.
_opaque_coverage: Percent of pixels with alpha > 128. Catches unfinished placeholder art that is mostly see-through outlines. Corpus distribution across 141 packs is sharply bimodal - p25 = 2.4%, p50 = 36.8%, nothing in between - so any threshold in the gap works and 25 is the middle of it. Control: M8SON's four tabs are 5.1-6.5% -> drop (they are dev placeholders, red 'UN SEL' / blue 'SEL' boxes).

predicates.why: 1.8.9 enchanting has two slots (lapis was added in 1.8); art with one, or with slots offset from that layout, renders misaligned on modern Minecraft
